scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate -w server && (if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then npm run db:deploy -w server; else echo 'DATABASE_URL ausente: migrações não aplicadas'; fi) && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
